name: 49327 · Grant, MI
findings: ZIP 49327 (Grant) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49327 (Grant) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49327 (Grant) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
